limits: Two fresh-process ordinary measurements per arm; nearest AB and BA pairs are retained, not a population estimate.
Timed preparation contains navigation, API, parsing and fixed settles, not isolated index construction.
Instrumented CPU and forced-GC retention workers are separate from ordinary measurements.
Retention is one warmed two-cycle batch per arm, not a leak-slope proof.
Rendered oracle checks labels/time/event ordering/ticks/control targets, not pixel/trail rendering.
